name: TheBaker
title: Freshly out of the oven!

description_panels.body: HI, I am the Baker! Thank you for the Ko-Fi! Buy Baker a slice of Pizza! If you wish to support me, please commission me by sending me a neat email at ffccomic@gmail.com! I am a simple bloke, I like to draw dumb doodles, make a comic and design cool characters for everyone to have fun!

description_panels.title: RAFFLE & Ko-Fi RULES
description_panels.body:
**RAFFLE RULES**
The "Roller" is a dastardly fiend,
with a villanous sense of humor. Raffles will commence at the start of stream, one after the other and entry is located in chat. Please enter when open. 
Once in, the roller will do his thing and you might be chosen 
to have your OC doodled based on that week's theme or the prior. 

**YOUR** choice.

No repeats winners in a biweekly time frame, otherwise you have to choose a winner.

**KO-FI RULES:**
All Ko-fis above **10 USD** get a colored doodle. 
(quality may vary based on amount)

 Less than that gets a quick one.

Turn time may be on
current stream or the next.

description_panels.title: FOXY FLAVORED COOKIE COMIC SERIES!
description_panels.body:
I also work on this 800+ Page comic series about a gang of Furry friends in the underground city of Paws Den. Funny, charming and tense story. Give it a try, it might be to you taste!

If you're interested, here is my more than 10 years ongoing comic series for you to binge!

**Foxy flavored cookie comic series**
